description: E001 is a reported actual protest with a domestic demand, but the body reports four arrests, not total crowd size. Arrest count cannot establish total attendance or a minimum.
required_followup: Seek permitted independent contemporaneous coverage with total/site attendance; leave pending_threshold without it.

description: E002 is a 20 March speech festival in Qom, Iran attended by Bahraini diaspora, with no stated number or explicit demand to Bahrain’s state. Country-unit ownership is unresolved.
required_followup: Review the project home-grown/country assignment rule and seek direct event materials or independent coverage only if permitted; otherwise keep pending_unit/pending_evidence.

description: E003 is supported as an actual local demonstration with a domestic political demand, but the only body-read source is a movement-affiliated retrospective calling it “massive” without a number or other crowd details.
required_followup: Search permitted independent contemporary/local reporting for 31 March South Sahlah and a site-specific crowd estimate; independent reviewer to decide whether the qualitative description supports >=50.

description: Open-web coverage is partial and search results skew to movement-affiliated sources; local/regional media, international coverage, official sources, rights groups and date windows were queried, but no systematic newspaper archive/LexisNexis access was available. Search output clocks and native per-query order metadata were not exposed.
required_followup: Continue feasible source-diverse and language-specific discovery around candidate dates and assess adjacent-month continuity. Do not claim exhaustive coverage.

description: A first open mistakenly omitted the “South Sahlah” slug segment and returned a tool-level internal error with no HTTP status/body. It was not the target URL and is not evidence or a denial for E003. The exact captured URL was then opened successfully; retain the error for audit.
required_followup: No retry of the mistyped URL. Use only the correctly opened target body for coding; request time for the failed attempt remains unknown.

description: For E001 and E003, sources do not establish the event close or protester violence; silence is not evidence of no violence. For E002, consequences are also not reported.
required_followup: Keep end dates and unreported violence unknown unless direct event-specific reporting is found.
